resources.string: Confirm the pairing request on the phone and radio.
Pairing or discovery failed. Check permissions and pairing mode, then retry.
No devices found. Put the radio or serial adapter into pairing mode, then search.
Put the radio or Bluetooth serial adapter into pairing mode. Choose its data connection, then confirm the system pairing dialog.

On IC-705, open SET > Bluetooth Set, turn Bluetooth on, then select <<Pairing Reception>>. Search below and pair with ICOM BT(IC-705). Confirm the matching passkey on both devices. If a PIN is requested, use the radio’s configured PIN (default 0000). Close other CAT apps before connecting.
Put the Bluetooth serial-to-CAT cable into pairing mode and select that adapter below. The FTX-1 Bluetooth audio connection does not provide CAT. Confirm the PIN supplied with your serial cable.
